def filter_api_calls(

    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be NumPy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices")
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("Input shapes must match")
    if shape[0] == 0 or shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must not be empty")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be finite")
    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("Log probabilities must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("Boolean values are invalid thresholds")
    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative scalar")

    # Compute normalized weights (Toolformer procedure T01)
    H = shape[1]
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * np.arange(H, dtype=float))
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if weight_sum == 0:
        raise ValueError("All weights are zero")
    weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Weighted sums of log probabilities
    weighted_with = np.dot(logp_with_result, weights)
    weighted_call = np.dot(logp_call_only, weights)
    weighted_no = np.dot(logp_no_call, weights)

    # Compute differences
    delta_with = weighted_with - weighted_no
    delta_call = weighted_with - weighted_call

    # Keep mask: both conditions must hold
    keep = (delta_with > tau_filter) & (delta_call > 0)

    # Margins (score minus threshold)
    margins = delta_with - tau_filter

    return (keep, margins.astype(np.float64))
